_comment: klayout-tools (klt) pin for the layout/ and sim/ flows. scripts/setup-env.sh installs this exact release into the repo-local .venv (never a host-wide tool). Append-only history: record later bumps as new entries in 'history', never edit an earlier one.
history: Issue #3: initial pin at klayout-tools main 267ea83 (merge of PR #3774), the commit whose docs/cli/sim.md the smoke request was written against.

Issue #42: bump to klayout-tools 0.8.0 from PyPI (tag v0.8.0, commit c572046be644). A PyPI install has no direct_url.json vcs_info, so scripts/setup-env.sh now verifies the installed version instead of the commit; klt_last_verified_commit records the tag commit for reference.

Issue #80: bump to klayout-tools 0.9.0 from PyPI (tag v0.9.0, commit 5dbbad05ff42), the version the batch fleet runner reports (runner_klt_version 0.9.0, re-read 2026-11-10); a client/runner skew made every batch unit error batch_runner_version_mismatch. Follows the fleet-tracking direction in 2AMLogic/2am#7038.
